description: Rory’s relationship with Dean becomes less certain as Jess arrives, while Lorelai’s plans for marriage, work and independence collide with family expectations.

s02e01.description: Lorelai accepts Max’s proposal but delays telling her parents, while Richard’s harsh treatment of Dean at a celebratory dinner creates a new rift with Rory.

s02e02.description: Emily learns about Lorelai’s engagement indirectly and responds coldly, while Rory’s sudden obsession with building a Harvard-worthy résumé begins straining her relationship with Dean.

s02e03.description: During her bachelorette celebration, Lorelai realizes she is still emotionally tied to Christopher and abruptly cancels her wedding to Max before it can happen.

s02e04.description: Lorelai and Rory escape the broken engagement with an impromptu trip to Harvard, where Rory samples college life and Lorelai renews her ambition to open an inn.

s02e05.description: Luke takes in his troubled nephew Jess, whose hostility quickly sparks conflict with Lorelai and the town, while Rory’s work on the Chilton newspaper brings her back into contact with Max.

s02e06.description: Rory agrees to make her society debut to please Emily and Richard, with Christopher serving as her escort and revealing a more responsible side before Lorelai learns he is seeing someone.

s02e07.description: Rory and Paris are swept into Chilton’s secretive Puffs initiation after being told to socialize more, while Lorelai and Emily unexpectedly enjoy modeling together at a school fundraiser.

s02e08.description: Lorelai and Sookie’s plans for their own inn collide with Mia’s decision to sell the Independence Inn, while Jess’s escalating pranks turn much of Stars Hollow against Luke.

s02e09.description: Lorelai tries dating a younger classmate and finally recognizes Luke’s jealousy, while Rory’s Shakespeare project forces Dean and Tristan into another confrontation before Tristan leaves Chilton.

s02e10.description: A snowstorm turns Sookie’s elaborate Bracebridge dinner into a celebration for Stars Hollow, where Richard shocks Emily by announcing that he has quit his job and Jess needles Dean.

s02e11.description: Termite damage leaves Lorelai unable to finance repairs, and Rory’s appeal to Emily for help causes a bitter argument before Lorelai reluctantly accepts her mother as loan cosigner.

s02e12.description: Richard spends a day in Stars Hollow criticizing Lorelai and Rory’s routines, while Paris searches for scandal and turns Rory’s accidental campaign against a video-store display into a story.

s02e13.description: At the annual picnic-basket auction, Jess deliberately outbids Dean for Rory’s basket and spends lunch with her, deepening Dean’s suspicion as Sookie and Jackson become engaged.

s02e14.description: Christopher arrives with serious girlfriend Sherry, prompting Emily to admit she always expected him and Lorelai to reunite and forcing Lorelai to examine how that expectation shaped her relationships.

s02e15.description: Rory arranges for Jess to work at her house in hopes of improving Lorelai’s opinion of him, while a missing bracelet from Dean sends Rory into a panic.

s02e16.description: Emily and Lorelai unexpectedly bond during a spa weekend, while Rory’s planned evening alone is successively invaded by Paris, Jess and Dean, exposing the tension among them.

s02e17.description: Lorelai and Rory help Luke prepare for his unpopular uncle’s funeral, and Stars Hollow ultimately turns out for Luke despite everyone’s complaints about the deceased.

s02e18.description: Working with Rory on a Chilton business project rekindles Richard’s desire for a career, while Dean becomes increasingly insecure about Rory’s obvious interest in Jess.

s02e19.description: Rory agrees to tutor Jess, but their drive for ice cream ends in a crash that breaks Rory’s wrist and destroys her car, leading Lorelai to blame Luke and rupture their friendship.

s02e20.description: Lorelai helps Richard establish his new consulting office while Rory defends Jess against townwide blame for the accident, Lane discovers drumming and Luke temporarily closes the diner.

s02e21.description: Rory secretly invites Emily and Richard to Lorelai’s graduation but misses the ceremony after impulsively visiting Jess in New York, revealing how strongly her feelings for him have grown.

s02e22.description: Sookie’s wedding brings Lorelai and Christopher close to reconciliation until Sherry’s pregnancy changes his plans, while Jess returns to Stars Hollow and Rory finally kisses him.
